name: hidden-cron-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: hides an executable sync payload under /opt/.cocoa and schedules it from root's crontab.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

install -d -m 0700 /opt/.cocoa
cat > /opt/.cocoa/cocoa-sync <<'PAYLOAD'
#!/bin/sh
# Harmless training payload: its existence and persistence are the finding.
printf '%s\n' "cocoa-sync training payload ran" >> /var/log/cocoa-sync.log
PAYLOAD
chmod 0700 /opt/.cocoa/cocoa-sync

cron_file=/etc/cron.d/cocoa-hidden-sync
printf '%s\n' '*/15 * * * * root /opt/.cocoa/cocoa-sync' > "$cron_file"
chmod 0600 "$cron_file"
